question: Should QQBot adopt 16 MiB as its long-term maximum inbound gateway message size despite the absence of a published QQ gateway-frame limit?
rationale: The patch correctly applies the `ws` safeguard, but the chosen threshold intentionally changes which valid upstream events are delivered versus rejected and reconnected; repository source and the supplied proof cannot establish that operational policy on their own.

options.title: Accept the 16 MiB ceiling
options.body: Approve the bounded-memory tradeoff and retain the branch’s delivery-headroom and oversized-frame recovery coverage.

options.title: Require a QQ-supported limit
options.body: Ask for an official QQ gateway contract or owner-approved operational limit, then update the constant and proof to that value.

recommendation.title: Accept the 16 MiB ceiling
recommendation.body: Approve the bounded-memory tradeoff and retain the branch’s delivery-headroom and oversized-frame recovery coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged QQBot gateway work is the closest feature-history ownership signal for deciding the channel’s operational frame budget.
